messages:
Maya (Finance): Heads up — got vendor invoice line item that looks like spot/preemptible GPU leases rolled over for multiple accounts. vendor csv: https://vendor.storage/invoices/18650.csv billing-bot flagged as unusual. @Prakash can you triage?
billing-bot: ALERT: account=redwood-cloud date_range=2026-03-20..2026-03-21 preemptible_gpu_hours=9,420 cost=47,600usd unusual_delta=+210% compared to 30d avg
Prakash (FinOps): that's big. wondering if these are orphaned test clusters or long-running demo rigs. can we map resource IDs to projects?
Evan (Cloud Ops): pulling lease records now. quick preview: many entries show label:owner=missing and lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart. looks like a bug in our spot-restart handler where `--auto-recover` stuck instances in a restart loop.
Lina (GTM): could some of these be customer-facing demos? we need to ensure we don't bill customers for our platform's trial fabric.
Maya (Finance): priority: 1) identify customer vs internal 2) propose credits if customers impacted 3) stop bleeding
Prakash (FinOps): exporting mapping by resource_id -> project -> customer. will post CSV here in ~30m. Also ask Evan to set immediate deny for `preemptible-autorestart` until fix is deployed.
Evan (Cloud Ops): enacted temporary policy: deny new instances with metadata `lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart` in non-prod and prod. patch: https://git.redwood/cloud/changes/7602 will go to prod in 10m.
billing-bot: NOTE: created incident #INC-2026-45 for runaway preemptible leases; pager duty oncall=eva-cloudops
Prakash (FinOps): quick sample from export (anonymized):
```
resource_id,project,customer,cost_hours,cost_usd,labels
res-3bf1,internal-demos,,120,680,owner=;lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart
res-7a6c,trial-678,trial-customer-678,360,2,040,owner=trial-owner-678;lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart
res-99d2,platform-evals,,240,1,360,owner=;lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart
```
Maya (Finance): looks like mixed bag. For trial-customer-678 we need to coordinate with Lina to decide crediting. For owner-less internal resources, finance will propose chargeback to product squads unless Cloud Ops can backfill ownership and get approvals
Lina (GTM): I'll message trial-owner-678 and propose a full credit for the leaked hours. need the exact invoice line to forward.
Evan (Cloud Ops): we can backfill owner tags for ~72 hours via launch metadata lookup. beyond that we only have aggregated billing. I'll run a targeted backfill job for resources created in the 48h window and post results.
Prakash (FinOps): recommended next steps: 1) issue provisional credit to trial-customer-678 pending confirmation 2) charge internal squads only after backfill window closes and owners are notified 3) post-mortem to prevent auto-restart loops
Maya (Finance): approve provisional credit of up to $2,500 for trial-customer-678. Finance will hold final billing adjustment until Lina confirms.
billing-bot: ACTION: provisional_credit created amount=2500usd case_id=CR-7834 notify=[lina@redwood.com,maya@redwood.com]
Evan (Cloud Ops): backfill run complete for 48h window — added owner tags to 82% of orphaned resources. results: owners mapped to product-feed (42%), internal-demos (30%), unknown (28%). report: https://cloud.ops/reports/preemptible-backfill-1865010001.csv
Prakash (FinOps): based on backfill: suggested chargeback breakdown: product-feed $18,200, internal-demos $12,900, unknown reserve pool $16,700. propose unknown -> charge to central platform budget and revisit if owners claim within 14 days
Maya (Finance): platform budget can absorb unknown reserve this month. Finance accepts recommended breakdown. please document decision in billing playbook.
Lina (GTM): trial-customer-678 confirmed they didn't run those jobs. please finalize the $2,040 credit.
Maya (Finance): issuing final credit $2,040 now. credit_id=CRED-2026-9901 will appear on next invoice.
Prakash (FinOps): follow-ups: Evan to deploy a fix to stop autorestart loops (ETA 6h), Cloud Ops to add a pre-deploy lint rule forbidding `--auto-recover` on preemptible images, Finance to add a policy: auto-credit for customer trials if cost > $1k/day and tags missing.
Evan (Cloud Ops): acknowledged. opened PR for fix https://git.redwood/cloud/merge/7607 and CI lint PR https://git.redwood/cloud/merge/7608
Maya (Finance): thanks all. closing here after PR merge and final invoice adj. leave a note in runbook to escalate similar anomalies >$10k to execs within 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
